categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: missile (rocket) solid engine power and control products, and ammunition equipment. It develops, manufactures, and sells solid engine power modules and control modules for missiles and rockets, as well as various types of ammunition including main ammunition, special ammunition, fuzes, and intelligent control products. Additionally, it produces civilian products such as cannon-fired hail suppression and rain enhancement munitions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary high-performance composite solid propellant formulations, advanced insulation composite materials, and high-efficiency manufacturing technologies for solid engine power modules. It has developed intelligent ignition and safety control modules with strong anti-interference and environmental adaptability. In ammunition, it possesses comprehensive design capabilities across all calibers, advanced warhead damage technologies, and precision fuze detection technologies. Production follows strict military standards with military representatives overseeing the entire process to ensure quality and security.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include various military branches of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, military industrial enterprises, authorized military trade companies, and military research institutions. The company also serves civilian meteorological departments through distributors for its hail suppression products. Major end markets are domestic military defense and international military trade, with expanding presence in international defense exhibitions and foreign military clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Nanchang, Jiangxi Province, China, with subsidiaries located in Jiangxi cities such as Nanchang, Taihe, and Jiujiang. Its operations and sales are primarily domestic within China, serving national defense clients, but it is actively expanding into international military trade markets through participation in global defense expos and establishing foreign customer relationships.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the military supply chain. It undertakes research, development, and manufacturing of missile solid engine modules and ammunition products, including final assembly and delivery to military clients. It also engages in contract research and development services for military clients. The company manages procurement of raw materials and components from qualified suppliers, including military-designated vendors, ensuring supply chain stability and quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in missile solid engine power and control technologies, focusing on new propellant formulations, advanced insulation materials, and intelligent ignition systems. The company emphasizes innovation in unmanned long-endurance boosters, smart ammunition, and informationized fuzes. It invests heavily in expanding production capacity, talent acquisition, and digitalization of design and manufacturing. The company also pursues military-civil integration by developing civilian applications of military technologies, such as weather modification munitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of military products to military units and military industrial customers, sales of civilian products via distributors, and contract research and development services commissioned by military clients. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and acceptance of products or upon progress in research contracts. Military product sales dominate revenue, accounting for over 97% of total income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few domestic enterprises engaged in missile solid engine power module research and production, holding a prominent position in the Chinese military industry. It competes primarily with major state-owned military industrial groups and local military enterprises. Its ammunition segment is recognized as a leading domestic producer of small and medium caliber ammunition, with several products at the forefront of technology and multiple military contracts. The company is also expanding its footprint in international military trade markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.2 billion, a 15.78% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 198.7 million, up 41.25%. R&D investment increased by 25.95% to RMB 91.17 million, representing 7.57% of revenue. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 3.16 billion and net assets of RMB 2.28 billion. Despite a temporary cash flow decline due to delayed military payments, adjusted cash flow from operations improved by 10.81%. The company shows a strong growth trajectory supported by expanding military orders and technological innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies in solid propellant formulations, insulation materials, and intelligent ignition and control systems, which provide superior performance, reliability, and safety. Its comprehensive ammunition design capabilities and smart fuze technologies offer differentiated combat effectiveness. The company’s strict quality control, military-grade production standards, and strong customer relationships ensure stable supply and product excellence. Its integration of military technology into civilian applications and expansion into international markets further enhance its competitive edge.
